shortDescription: Indonesia exported goods worth $26.22 billion in July, up 6.05% from the same month a year earlier, official data showed on Monday, compared with a 3.36% annual growth expected in a Reuters poll.Statistics Indonesia was due to release imports and trade balance data later on Tuesday.
